title: Zainab ne Tadapkar Ye Pukaara Mere Abbas
body:
Hai laashe bikhre hue rege garme karbal par.
Pareshaa'n bibiya'n hain ghash mein Abid e muztar.
Dilasa deti hui sabko duqtar e Hyder s.a.
Nigaahein bibi ki hain, alqama ke saahil par.
Zainab s.a. ne tadapkar yeh pukara mere Abbas asws.
Ghar lut gaya main hogayi.....**2.
Ghar lut gaya main hogayi tanha mere Abbas asws.
1. Bachon ko mere bhayi pe qurbaa'n kiya maine..**2. phir bhi na bachaa....**2
Phir bhi na bachaa zehra s.a. ka jaaya mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Qasim asws. ka hua aqd wo maqtal ko sidhara..**2.
Kuch der ki......**2
Kuch der ki dulhan hui bewa mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Atthaara(18) baras naazo'n se maine jise paala..**2.
Tar qoon mein tha....**2
Tar qoon mein tha uska bhi laasha mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Besheer ki gardan pe laga teer sitam ka..**2
Doo'n bano s.a. ko ab....**2.
Doo'n bano s.a. ko ab kistarha pursa mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sar saare shaheedo'n ke chadhe noke sina par..**2.
Paamal hua.....**2.
Paamal hua bhaayi ka laasha mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Be goro kafan dhoop mein the dasht mein laashe..**2.
Be chadari....**2.
Bechadari ne mujhko rulaya mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Waaqif hun main tum thak gaye aur karte ho aaram..**2.
Shab dhalti hain main....**2.
Shab dhalti hai main deti hun pehra mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Masoom ko lagte hain tamache kabhi durre..**2.
Deti hai sadaa....**2.
Deti hai sadaa tumko Sakina s.a. mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Har bibi rasan basta hain chadar nahi sar par..**2.
Sajjad asws. hai zanjeer mein....**2.
Sajjad asws. hai zanjeer mein jakda mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Oonto'n se wo girte hue aagosh ke paale..**2.
Tum dekhte maaou'n ka......**2.
Tum dekhte maaou'n ka tadapna mere Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Kehti thi rasheed ashk bahakar yahi Zainab asws...**2.
Chadar ke muhafiz....**2.
Chadar ke muhafiz mere bhaiya mere Abbas asws.
Kalaam: janab Rasheed Shaheedi sahab.
